lines.zh: 我在屋里来回走动，等人。
lines.en: Pacing the room, waiting for someone.
Door to window is exactly ten paces.

lines.zh: 我把外套扣好，走出两步。
lines.en: Buttoning my coat, two steps out.

lines.zh: 脚步放轻，别惊了楼下的老人。
lines.en: Soft steps — don't wake the old man below.

lines.zh: 绕着桌子走一圈，想想怎么说。
lines.en: One lap of the table, thinking what to say.
My boots are cleaned carefully.

lines.zh: 走过去看看门有没有关。
lines.en: Walking over to check the door.
I remember the mission — follow me.
From the shadow into the lamplight.
No hurry. One step, one word.
Narrow stair — I turn sideways.

lines.zh: 手指敲着剑柄，边走边想。
lines.en: Fingers on the hilt, walking and thinking.
I stop at the door and wait for you.

lines.zh: 鞋跟在地板上响了两声。
lines.en: Two clicks of my heel on the floor.
The rain outside hasn't stopped.
I've carried this pen for years.

lines.zh: 我把话在心里排了三遍。
lines.en: I've rehearsed the words three times.
The wick's getting short.
I look up at the ceiling.
What must be said must be said.
Hand on the sword — just habit.
Did someone pass outside?
I loosen my collar.

lines.zh: 这屋子里的钟走得很慢。
lines.en: The clock in here runs slow.
Wondering if it's worth it.
You came. I've waited a long time.
Sit down. Let's talk.
There's something I need to ask of you.

lines.zh: 你身上有时间旅行的痕迹。
lines.en: You carry traces of time travel.
No rush. Catch your breath first.
I've heard your name.
Will you believe it if I say it?
Please put the weapon down first.

lines.zh: 你看起来比我预想的年轻。
lines.en: You look younger than I expected.
I speak plainly. Don't take offense.

lines.zh: 这扇门关着，话就留在这里。
lines.en: The door's shut, so the words stay here.
Where did you come from? Be clear.
I know you don't trust me.

lines.zh: 留给我们的时间不多了。
lines.en: We don't have much time left.

lines.zh: 站在门口也行，听完再走。
lines.en: Standing in the doorway is fine. Just hear me out.
The choice is yours.
Back to the table. Steady.
That cut my sentence short.
My sleeve's been cut open.
I can still stand, for now.
It hurts, but I can still talk.
Just let me lean on the table.
Blood drips onto the map.
Don't worry — not a vital spot.
I'll bite down and hear you out.
I won't last long like this.
Tea is fine. My mind's in a mess.

lines.zh: 这些吃的你留着路上用。
lines.en: Keep that food for the road.
I'm not very hungry. Thank you.
A piece of bread would be fine.

lines.zh: 吃东西的时候别说正事。
lines.en: Let's not discuss serious things while eating.
Is this water clean?
Food steadies my hands.
Leave it. I'll eat later.
You're too kind. I'm not used to it.
One bite is enough. I still have to go.
Sorry, I was distracted.

lines.zh: 门就这么宽，我们挤一挤。
lines.en: The door's narrow. Let's squeeze through.
The mission comes first; let me pass.

lines.zh: 让一下，我要拿桌上的东西。
lines.en: Excuse me, I need what's on the table.
Don't block the doorway.
This hallway is far too narrow.
A bump's nothing. Don't tense up.
I'll shift aside. Go ahead.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起了，像两个孩子。
lines.en: We collided like two children.
The table knocked once.
I've other things I must do.

lines.zh: 现在不是谈这个的时候。
lines.en: This isn't the time for that.
I don't plan to stay here long.
I owe someone an answer.
I haven't thought about it.
There's a road I haven't finished.
Don't say it too soon.
Someone like me isn't settled.
Another time, all right?
Let's finish what matters first.
This paper fell on the floor.
I gather up what was dropped.
This badge isn't mine.
A key — whose?
Pick it up and return it.
This fragment of map is useful.
Don't step on it — I'll get it.
A stub of candle, still usable.
Into my inner pocket.
Clearing the table.
There's someone standing behind you.
Footsteps outside the door.
Don't make a sound. Listen.

lines.zh: 把手放在能看见的地方。
lines.en: Keep your hands where I can see them.
I know how to handle this.
Stay right there.
Someone's got their eye on us.
I need to confirm their intent.
This door won't hold long.
I'll open the door on three.

lines.zh: 他的脚步在门口停住了。
lines.en: His steps stopped at the door.
I can tell there are two of them.

lines.zh: 他们不敲门，就是不想等。
lines.en: They aren't knocking — they won't wait.
I'll speak. You stay back.
Keep the lamp on the doorway.
That step was too heavy.
His shadow's under the door.
Wait for him to show himself.
I still have one way out.
Don't let this flame go out.
Sorry. I have to act.
The scabbard hits your hand first.
I'll use only this one.
Parry his weapon and step back.
Don't make me strike hard.
I put too much into that.
Blade stays sheathed; I use the hilt.
I push you off, then leave.
My hand's shaking. Don't blame me.
Enough. Everyone stand down.
I step out from behind the door.

lines.zh: 这间屋子是我约的地方。
lines.en: This room is where I asked to meet.
I smooth my coat and stand.
A map is spread on the table.
The lamp's still lit. I'm waiting.
Someone just passed in the hall.
I'm here. I have something to say.
I take my hand off the hilt.
It's strangely quiet outside.
The door opens. I look up.
Flame jumped onto my coat.

lines.zh: 我从台阶上摔下来，手肘破了。
lines.en: Fell from the steps, elbow split.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，我说不出话。
lines.en: Water in my throat — I can't speak.
The blast shattered the window.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在门框上，擦过我。
lines.en: An arrow hit the frame, grazing me.
That spell crawled into my bones.
I haven't eaten all day.
The strike left me numb all over.

lines.zh: 脚下空了，我抓不住什么。
lines.en: Nothing under me. Nothing to grab.
